svg.aria-label: Spain invoice actions: send, correct or cancel
svg.title: Spain invoice actions: send, correct or cancel
svg.desc: Separate proposal copied from invoice-sending-end-to-end-workflow.drawio. The customer chooses Send, Correct or Cancel. Correction creates a new invoice and joins existing sending step 1. Cancellation checks the earlier submission, state, reason and authority, then records its independent result. Full customer rejection does not automatically cancel an invoice. The existing sending steps, route branches and independent results are retained. Sage cancellation contracts and Spain implementation support remain unqualified.
